narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On May 28, 2024, at approximately 1105 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a farm stand in Coloma, Michigan, after a deputy asked for help identifying a person without identification. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and that he has no documents.
ENTRY:
According to the subject, his first trip north was in 2015 through the desert near Nogales, Arizona; he worked in Tucson until he returned to Chihuahua in 2019.
On his last trip, in November 2021, he crossed on foot through a gap in the fence on the west side of El Paso, Texas, and took a bus to Michigan a week later.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
